label_rule: window is positive iff it contains >=1 CI object (ci_label=1), same generator as the official benchmark
rules: time-based: no timestamp appears in two splits
benchmark is used only for the final comparison with v0, never for tuning
threshold and hyper-parameters are chosen on dev only
test is opened once; all reported test numbers use the dev-selected threshold
the dense mask y in the zarr is NOT used as a label source (it has large -1 unknown regions)
